title: Dell Alienware Command Center (AWCC), versions prior to 6.14.54.0, contain a Least Privilege Violation vulnerability. (CVE-2026-81452)
description: Dell Alienware Command Center (AWCC) versions prior to 6.14.54.0 contain a Least Privilege Violation vulnerability (CVE-2026-81452). This flaw allows a low privileged local attacker to potentially elevate privileges and cause denial of service. The vulnerability has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 7. No patch or remediation details are provided in the available data.
aiSummary: CVE-2026-81452 is a Least Privilege Violation vulnerability in Dell Alienware Command Center (AWCC) affecting versions before 6.14.54.0. It enables a low privileged attacker with local access to escalate privileges and disrupt service, leading to potential elevation of privilege and denial of service conditions. The CVSS 3.1 base score is 7.0, reflecting high impact on confidentiality, integrity, and availability. No vendor advisory or patch information is currently available to confirm remediation status.
aiImpact: An attacker with low privileges and local access could exploit this vulnerability to gain elevated privileges and cause denial of service, impacting system confidentiality, integrity, and availability.
